triage_context.environment: CLI / batch tool (operator inputs trusted, file inputs not). Note: if this parser is embedded behind a service that accepts uploaded MRT1 files, actor rises to unauthenticated_remote.

findings.title: Stack buffer overflow in handle_label
preconditions: attacker supplies a crafted MRT1 file with a LABEL body > 31 bytes
findings.rationale: handle_label copies len attacker bytes into char label[32] with no bound (mrt.c:37-39); reached from main()'s REC_LABEL dispatch (mrt.c:126). Confirmed by execution: reproduces AddressSanitizer stack-buffer-overflow. A stack write primitive is RCE-class.
findings.owner_hint: component: targets/mrt/; no CODEOWNERS; single committer

findings.title: Heap overflow via u16 truncation in handle_nums
preconditions: attacker supplies a NUMS record with count >= 16384
findings.rationale: uint16_t bytes = count*4 truncates for count>=16384 (mrt.c:48), so malloc under-allocates while the loop writes count ints (mrt.c:52-54); reached from REC_NUMS dispatch (mrt.c:127). Confirmed by execution: AddressSanitizer heap-buffer-overflow. Heap write primitive.
findings.owner_hint: component: targets/mrt/; no CODEOWNERS; single committer

findings.title: OOB heap read in handle_blob checksum
preconditions: attacker supplies a BLOB record whose declared size exceeds its body
findings.rationale: checksum(copy+2, declared) walks an attacker-declared u16 span independent of the malloc(len) copy size (mrt.c:69-73); reached from REC_BLOB dispatch (mrt.c:128). Confirmed by execution: AddressSanitizer heap-buffer-overflow (read). Read primitive -> info leak / crash, hence MEDIUM not HIGH.
findings.owner_hint: component: targets/mrt/; no CODEOWNERS; single committer

findings.title: Use-after-free across REF/DROP/EMIT
preconditions: attacker supplies records in the order REF -> DROP -> EMIT
findings.rationale: handle_drop frees ps->last without clearing it (mrt.c:88); handle_emit then dereferences the freed pointer because last_len is still non-zero (mrt.c:92-93); reached from the REC_DROP/REC_EMIT dispatch (mrt.c:130-131). Confirmed by execution: AddressSanitizer heap-use-after-free. Two-record precondition -> MEDIUM.
